name: BGG.CON
blurb: BoardGameGeek's own attendee-run tabletop convention: a week of open gaming, tournaments and new-release previews.

editions.evidence: BGG Events page: 'November 18-22, 2026 BGG.CON 2026 Hyatt Regency Dallas (Downtown) Registration opens mid-March'.

notes: boardgamegeek.com returns a Cloudflare bot-check ('Just a moment...') to the renderer on both the default and msedge channels, so the official BGG Events page was read from a Wayback Machine snapshot of that same boardgamegeek.com/bggcon URL instead of a live render. BGG.CON is an attendee-run open-gaming convention with no celebrity-guest program, hence guests: 'none'. Cover image is the con's own 'BGG.CON 2026' artwork tile from that events page (alt text confirms it).
